item.tib: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i skang bshags rin chen spungs pa
item.coloph: skong bshags rin chen spungs pa zhes bya ba 'di/ ye shes mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma'i/ (mas) dus mtha'i rnal 'byor drung mu wer ro la/ ston zla tha chung tshes pa bco lnga la/ dben gnas g.yu khra phug tu snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya (thubs) par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ bla ma rig 'dzin rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
